The '''''Horizon''''' was a [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]]. It was a part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
